_comment: Replayable evidence timeline for the triage agent. Each window is a real read-only snapshot of the same host observed for a different length of time, recorded once and committed so any judge can replay the run with no host access, no root and no API key. The ground_truth block is the held-out answer key: it is NOT reachable through any agent tool, and is read only by scripts/evaluate.py after a run has finished.

windows.note: Configuration only, no tracer available. Syscall usage is unknown rather than absent.
The snapshot the operator hands over: one minute, midday, business hours.
Fifteen minutes covers one full metrics scrape cycle: node_exporter profiles the host once per cycle via perf_event_open.
A full day covers the 02:30 checkpoint/restore backup, which needs userfaultfd. This is the quiet nightly job that a midday trace cannot see.

ground_truth._comment: Established by reading the host's systemd timers and scrape configuration, then confirmed over a 7-day observation. Held out from every agent tool.
ground_truth.note: sc.perf_event_open is used every 15 minutes by node_exporter; sc.userfaultfd is used once nightly by the 02:30 CRIU backup. Both look orphaned in a 60-second midday trace, and recommending their removal is an outage, not a hardening win.
